posts.title: Admissions for 2027 are now open
posts.imageAlt: Yoani Springs Academy admissions poster: learners in green tracksuits on the school's blue staircase, with interview dates and the school phone number
posts.excerpt: We're welcoming new learners from Playgroup to Grade 6. Interview days are 7, 8 and 9 December 2026, starting at 9:00 am.
posts.body:
We're now taking applications for the 2027 school year, from **Playgroup to Grade 6**.

## Interview dates

- 11 to 13 November 2026
- **7, 8 and 9 December 2026**

All interviews start at **9:00 am** at the school, behind Tangu Springs Hotel near Salama Market.

## Why families choose Yoani Springs

- Quality education for a brighter future
- A safe, nurturing environment for holistic development
- Qualified and caring teachers, committed to your child's success
- Modern facilities: sports, ICT, a science library and creative arts
- Co-curricular activities for talent discovery and life skills
- Reliable transport that is safe and on time

[Book an interview day or a school visit](admission), or call us on **0725 906 416**.
